ad_library.summary: Sunova Green Energy is running 1 active Meta ad (Facebook), started 31 August 2026. The ad stacks a Rs. 1,00,000 saving claim - Rs. 78,000 government subsidy plus a Rs. 22,000 discount - with 30-year performance life, 7+ years of experience, 5-year AMC and 'Trusted by 500+ Homes Across Hyderabad'. The click lands on an fb.me lead form inside Facebook, so the spend never reaches sunovagreenenergy.com. The site itself is a WordPress/Elementor build covering residential, commercial and housing-society rooftop solar, on-grid / off-grid / hybrid systems, solar water heaters, fencing and street lights, with a Banjara Hills corporate office and a Gmail contact address. No Google Ads advertiser record was checked for this report - that requires the full pipeline.

funnel.meaning: Every click opens a Facebook surface, not sunovagreenenergy.com. You own no pixel on the landing experience, you cannot retarget the people who clicked and did not enquire, and there is no page you can test a different headline or price on. With a single ad live there is also no second creative angle to learn from.

findings: The one live ad (since 31 Aug 2026) clicks to an fb.me lead form inside Facebook - the spend never reaches sunovagreenenergy.com, so no pixel, no retargeting pool, no testable landing page.

The ad's claim set (Rs. 78,000 subsidy + Rs. 22,000 discount + 5-year AMC + 500+ homes + 7+ years) is backed by the site's service pages - on-grid, off-grid and hybrid systems, housing-society installs, solar water heaters, fencing, street lights - but the paid traffic never sees any of that proof.
One ad, one angle (subsidy + discount), all cold traffic. There is no retargeting ad behind it and no second creative to test the AMC angle against the subsidy angle.

Contact identity is split: the site publishes a Gmail address (sunovagreenenergy@gmail.com) as the enquiry route while the ad points to an in-Facebook form - an enquiry can land in two places or none.
The ad is 7+ weeks old with no newer creative visible in the Ad Library - a refresh is due before fatigue sets in.
next_steps: Move the click onto a page you own
Point the ad at a dedicated Hyderabad landing page carrying the same Rs. 78,000 + Rs. 22,000 + 5-year AMC offer, an enquiry form and the Meta Pixel - so every click is measurable and retargetable.
One pixel plus the Conversions API gives you the audience of everyone who clicked but did not submit the fb.me form - usually 10-20x the people who fill a form.
Test the AMC angle as a second creative
5-year comprehensive AMC support is a different buying trigger from the subsidy - a second creative tells you which one actually converts.
Route the fb.me form alerts and the site contact address to the same inbox so an enquiry can never sit unread.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
